_comment: TEMPLATE for a PRIVATE user/profile settings overlay (docs/PROFILES.md). Replace <private-gcp-project> with the one explicitly authorized non-production project. Never commit the real project name to this public repository. No rule here reads a secret value: `gcloud secrets versions access` stays ask-gated by the tracked baseline, and ask always beats allow. The ask entries close three bypasses: a fully-qualified `projects/<other>/secrets/<id>` argument (gcloud lets it override --project), service-account impersonation, and uploading a local file at create time. Ask globs have no space around `*` so the flag is caught in any position, including directly after the subcommand or before it.
